title: Enterprise Connectivity: collection grace period
content:
## Tier basis
Enterprise Connectivity uses the following collection grace period for each named contract tier. Calendar days after invoice maturity before collection suspension; integer.

## Tier comparison
| Contract tier | Facet | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps | collection grace period | 15 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 250 Mbps | collection grace period | 15 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 500 Mbps | collection grace period | 15 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 1 Gbps | collection grace period | 15 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 2 Gbps | collection grace period | 15 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 5 Gbps | collection grace period | 15 |

## Basis Q&A
For the Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps tier, the collection grace period is 15.
